text: Coffee with Zainab. Her dad's back in hospital with pneumonia, second time since August. She's exhausted and sleeping at her sister's. Remind me to check in on Friday.

Sean and his wife Imani picked up the new puppy on Saturday, a beagle called Biscuit. Already chewed through a charger. Vet jabs booked for October 28. Imani's been working from home to keep an eye on him and says she's getting nothing done. Sean reckons they'll do puppy classes in the new year once he's had all his injections.
Ricardo sprained his ankle at five-a-side, on crutches for a few weeks. Says he's going stir crazy. His mum's coming over from Lisbon sometime next month to help out.
Arjun's daughter Meera has chickenpox so he's off work all week. Should drop round some soup and those colouring books.

Long catch up with Kasia. Her cat Pepper has kidney trouble and needs a special diet now, costing a fortune. She's also starting a new job at the council on 2 November 2026. Nervous about it but mostly excited. Partner Emil is doing the school runs so she can settle in. Need to text her good luck the night before.
Rahul says his knee op got moved to March 2027, which he's gutted about. Still limping. Ask him about physio in the new year.
Imani's 40th was meant to be Nov 14 but she's called it off, her gran isn't well and she'd rather go up to Leeds. Must send her something anyway.
Hassan's dog Rolo turned 10 on Sunday. They did a little cake. Hassan is weirdly emotional about it.

Tobi broke his wrist skateboarding, of all things, at 38. Cast off around Christmas. His boss has been decent about it, letting him work from home. He's annoyed because he'd entered the Brighton half marathon for April and now probably can't train. His sister Grace is getting married in June 2027 and he's best man, so he's also panicking about the speech.
Kalani's son Ezra got glandular fever, been off school three weeks. Kalani is worn out. Their holiday to Kauai in the spring is probably still on if he's better.
pick up worming tablets + flea stuff for the cat. vet closes at 5:30 thurs
Phone call with Omar. His mother has early dementia, diagnosis appointment confirmed for 11/3. He's trying to get his brother Bilal to come over from Manchester for it. Ring Omar the day after.
Ryan mentioned Anya's been having migraines again, really bad ones. Neurologist referral should come through soon. Don't bring it up unless she does.
Ethan and Rhys are adopting a rescue greyhound, collecting her in December. Name TBC. They're both properly obsessed already.
Shreya - allergic to cats, avoid the cafe with the shop cat next time. Loves hiking, did Snowdon last month.
Bridget fell on the ice last winter and her hip still isn't right. Physio twice a week. She's on a waiting list for a scan, maybe February. I should offer lifts.
Sana's little girl had her tonsils out yesterday. Recovering at home, eating ice lollies nonstop. Send a card to Sana's house this week.
Emil says Kasia's new job is going well so far. Pepper's bloods came back better than expected too.
Quick one: Ming's hamster died. Her son Leo is devastated, it was his first pet. Ming's getting him a kitten in the new year maybe.
Joe had his gallbladder out on June 3rd this year, still not 100%. Back at the gym though. Big Arsenal fan, wants tickets for his birthday on May 14.

Ran into Siddharth and his wife Priya at the vet. Their spaniel Mabel swallowed a sock and needed surgery. She's fine now. Siddharth looked shattered. They're also moving to Bristol sometime next year once the flat sells. Priya said the surgery cost nearly two grand and the insurance is arguing about it. Their son Kabir is doing his GCSEs this year so they don't want to move until after the summer if they can help it.
Marcus's dad had a heart attack on Tuesday. Stable, in ICU at St Thomas'. Marcus is flying back from Dubai tonight. Must call him over the weekend.
Nikhil wants a dog but his landlord says no. Thinking about fostering instead. Into bouldering, goes Thursdays.

Aaliyah's mum is having chemo from early December, every three weeks until March 2027. Aaliyah is moving back home to help. She sounded okay but she'd been crying. Need to organise a meal rota with Sana and Bridget. She also said her brother Tariq is flying in from Toronto for Christmas to give her a break. Her own birthday is December 21 and she said she just wants a quiet one, maybe a nice candle or bath stuff.
Bruno's cat Mochi went missing last Wednesday. Posters up all round Hackney. Bruno hasn't really slept. Ask him tomorrow if there's any news.
Gareth (Gaz) has shingles, poor bloke. Off work till at least 10/30. His wife Sian is due with their second in January so timing's awful.
Patrick's retiring end of March 2027 after 31 years at the hospital. Leaving do sometime in April. Thinking a decent bottle of whisky, he mentioned Lagavulin twice.
Ibrahim twisted his back lifting the sofa. Off his feet for a week. His kids Yusuf and Amira have been bringing him tea in bed which he loves.
Aneesh's grandad turns 90 on December 7th! Big family party in Leicester. Aneesh is doing a slideshow and is stressed about it.
Zainab update - dad's home from hospital, much better. She's back at work Monday and less frazzled. Her cat Simba had kittens too, five of them. She's trying to rehome them before Christmas.
Need to book my flu jab and the MOT before the end of November. Also dentist, sometime in the new year.

Sean says Biscuit has been sick twice and they're taking him to the vet tomorrow morning. Probably ate something in the park. Imani is panicking. Text Sean tomorrow afternoon to see what the vet said.

Lunch with Ricardo and Arjun. Ricardo's ankle is healing, off crutches. Arjun's wife Divya is pregnant, due May 2027! They haven't told family yet. Ricardo's taking his mum to the Algarve after Christmas. Arjun's daughter is better and back at nursery. Good to see them both.
Rhys rang. The greyhound pickup is delayed to January because she needs a dental. They've named her Juno. He also mentioned his sister Cerys has a new job in Cardiff starting 1/12.
Kalani's mum Leilani is visiting from Honolulu Nov 20 to Dec 4. Kalani wants recommendations for a nice dinner spot. Send her that Thai place.
Hassan's daughter Noor starts uni in Glasgow next September. He's already sad about it. Noor is vegetarian and loves anime.
Imani says her gran passed away on Thursday night. Funeral probably early next week in Leeds. Imani's okay-ish, mostly holding it together for her mum. Send flowers to her mum's address.
Catch up with Tobi. Wrist is mending, cast off on December 19 2026 hopefully. He's been learning to draw left-handed. His partner Ming is doing all the cooking and is sick of it, ha.
Omar's mum got the dementia diagnosis. Expected but still hard. Bilal is staying for a fortnight. Omar seems flat. Should take him for a pint soon.
Anya's neurologist appointment is 12/2 at 9am. Ryan's going with her. She's nervous about it, worried it's something serious. I should text her the evening before and again that afternoon.
Ethan says his mum's knee replacement went well yesterday, home by Friday they reckon. He's going up to Newcastle at the weekend to help.
Bridget's scan finally booked: 3 February 2027. Her husband Dennis has had a cold for a month too, so the house is a sickbay apparently.
Sana wants to get her daughter a guinea pig for Christmas. Asked if I knew any good rescues. Message her the link to the Battersea small animals page.
Quick note after the school gates: Joe's son Finn broke his arm falling off the climbing frame. Joe and his wife Rosa were at A&E till midnight. Finn is loving the attention and the purple cast.
Siddharth says the Bristol move is happening March 2027, they've had an offer. Mabel's fully recovered. Priya got a job at the university there.

Marcus's dad is out of ICU and on a ward. Marcus is staying in London for the foreseeable. He mentioned he's not sleeping, using the hospital chapel to have a cry. Call him Sunday, and maybe check if he needs anything for the flat.
Nikhil's started fostering a staffie called Dottie! Already wants to keep her. Hard no from the landlord still.
Aaliyah texted, first chemo session for her mum is moved to Dec 9. Meal rota sorted with Sana, Bridget's on Wednesdays.
Bruno found Mochi!! Under a neighbour's shed, thin but okay. Vet check on Monday. Bruno's buying the neighbours a hamper, which is very Bruno.
Gaz is back at work, shingles cleared up. Sian had a scare and a scan but baby's fine. Due date still Jan 17.

Patrick's wife Maureen has had a fall and broken her shoulder. He's doing everything at home now. Still on for retiring in March but says he's lost interest in the leaving do. Drop off a lasagne this week. Patrick's son Liam is coming home from Australia for a few weeks after New Year to help, which will take the pressure off a bit. Maureen's operation is penciled in for 11/8 if the swelling goes down.

Ibrahim says his back is better. Yusuf has his grade 3 piano exam on Nov 22, practising every evening. Amira wants a karaoke machine for her 8th birthday, 12/18. His wife Fatima mentioned their old cat Smudge isn't eating much and might have to be put down soon, the kids don't know yet. Ibrahim is dreading it.
Aneesh's slideshow went down a storm at his grandad's party, people were crying. Grandad wants a copy. Aneesh's aunt Leela is apparently unwell but he didn't say much.
The cat's been off her food since Sunday. If she's still not eating by Thursday, book the vet.
Shreya started a new role at the zoo, in the reptile house! Tells me she's terrified of the crocodiles but loves the tortoises. Her boyfriend Rahul has been off with flu for a week.
Rahul's knee op is March 18 2027 now, confirmed. He's worried about the recovery, it's 12 weeks before he can drive. Needs someone to walk his dog Bruce while he's laid up. I'll offer.
Kasia and Emil's anniversary is sometime in November, she can't remember the date, ha. Emil's planning a weekend in Kraków. Kasia's dad isn't well though so it might get pushed to spring.
Zainab's kittens are all rehomed except the runt. She's keeping that one, called him Pip. Zainab's son Adam has asthma so they're watching how he gets on with it.
Imani got through the funeral. Says her mum is struggling more than she is. Imani is taking her away somewhere warm after Christmas, maybe Lanzarote. Check in with Imani in a week or two.

Good long FaceTime with Tobi and Kalani, first time all three of us together in ages. Kalani's son Ezra is finally over the glandular fever and back at school, though he gets tired by the afternoons. Kauai trip is booked for April 2027. Tobi's cast comes off on December 19 and he's planning to celebrate with a curry. Kalani's dog Koa had a tooth out last week and is wearing the cone of shame. Tobi said Ming wants a cookbook for her birthday, which is February 9. Remind me to order that in January.
